text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry… And after you made such a case about how I should be careful of potential injuries…
choice_data_list: I should've been more vigilant too…
I should've been more vigilant too…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: This is going to worry my security team again…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: …No. At times like these, I probably ought to put them at ease by showing them I can still move about.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: It could be like rehabilitation. …What do you think, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: It could be like rehabilitation. …What do you think, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: But… what if they say I shouldn't enter any more races?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I tell her that, even then, I'm not willing to let her put herself in danger. I also explain that if she's trying to put minds at ease, then overexerting herself will have the opposite effect.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: …You're right. You're totally right. I think I was just panicked.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Thank you for stopping me, but I wish you hadn't seen that side of me. It's pitiful…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fine Motion puts on a vaguely dispirited smile and agrees to take time off to rest.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yes, of cour—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ugh!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ngh… Excuse me… I'm all right. But if it hurts this much, then…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I explain that if she rests properly and lets her injury heal, she should be fine. I also tell her that I'll explain the situation to her security team myself so she doesn't need to worry about that.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: …My apologies. I caused more trouble for you…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fine Motion goes quiet as if she's trying to stifle her sighs.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yes! It'll be fine, trust me.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: What do you think? Pulled it off without a hitch, didn't I? Besides, if I run in here, it'll be even safer than running outside.

text_block_list.name: Security Captain
choice_data_list: If it hurts her even a little, we'll switch to classroom study.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh! That's a grand idea. ♪ We could do visualization exercises!

text_block_list.name: Security Captain
text_block_list.text: Huh… I have a clear idea of just how passionate you both are now. All the same, I would ask you to remain cautious.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Okay then, Trainer! Let's work hard at whatever training we can! ♪ Huzzah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A dazzling smile lights up Fine Motion's face. I'd better come up with a training plan fast!
